id.description: Public recommendation id in the form "com_{n}".

class.description: Commercial class. Values: sponsored (an ad-style promotion heard at that moment: a paid sponsor read, promo code, affiliate plug, thanks for supplied goods or venue, or a show promoting its own product as an ad), organic (an unpaid personal recommendation), mention (a neutral commercial mention).

id.description: Public entity id in the form "ent_{n}".

type.description: Entity type. Values: person (an individual), organization (a company or institution; legacy entities may read company or brand), product (a product or service), topic (a subject or theme), channel (a media source such as a YouTube channel), unknown (type was never classified).

slug.description: URL slug, the site's canonical id for every type but channel. Null when never slugged.

page.description: The entity's page on arcmira.com, absolute. Link the name to it when you write the entity into an answer. Null for a type the site has no page for.

channel_id.description: YouTube channel id of the source channel.

id.description: Public entity id ("ent_{n}") of the source channel.

source_channel.description: The channel entity that published the video. Null when the video has not been linked to a channel entity.

start_seconds.description: Start position in the video in integer seconds. 0 means "full episode / no specific moment". Null when the analyzer could not place it in time.

end_seconds.description: End position in the video in integer seconds. 0 means "full episode / no specific moment". Null when the analyzer could not place it in time.

verbatim_quote.description: Verbatim quote from the transcript. Null when no quote was extracted.

promo_code.description: Promo code read out in the mention. Null unless one was detected.

offer.description: Offer text, e.g. "20% off your first order". Null unless one was detected.

sentiment.description: DEPRECATED: use sentiment_score, which carries the same number. Removal will be announced in the changelog. Raw NUMERIC sentiment score between -1 and 1. Null when not computed.

sentiment_score.description: Raw sentiment score between -1 and 1, same semantics as sentiment_score on mentions. Null when not computed.

confidence.description: Classifier confidence between 0 and 1. Recommendations below the min_confidence filter (default 0.7) are excluded from list responses.

speaker_role.description: Role of the speaker delivering the mention, e.g. "host" or "guest".

conflict_status.description: Set when community feedback disputes the classification (e.g. "disputed"). Null when undisputed. Disputed recommendations are excluded unless include_disputed=true.

resolution.description: How a disputed classification was resolved. Null until a dispute has been resolved.

has_more.description: True when more results exist past this page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

id.description: Public entity id in the form "ent_{n}". Always the canonical entity id.

canonical_id.description: Public id of the canonical entity. Identical to id.

type.description: Entity type. Values: person (an individual), organization (a company or institution; legacy entities may read company or brand), product (a product or service), topic (a subject or theme), channel (a media source such as a YouTube channel), unknown (type was never classified).

platform.description: Source platform for channel entities, e.g. "youtube". Null unless the entity is platform-bound.

url.description: Canonical external URL for the entity. Null when none is known.

image_url.description: Entity image URL. Null until an image has been resolved.

image_checked_at.description: Timestamp of the last image resolution attempt. Null until the image pipeline has visited this entity.

appearance_count.description: Number of indexed appearances and mentions of this entity. 0 when never counted.

owner_entity_id.description: Public id ("ent_{n}") of the owning entity, e.g. the organization behind a product. Null unless an ownership link exists.

is_canonical.description: True when the id you supplied is the canonical entity. False when your id was merged into this canonical record.

merged_from_id.description: Public id you supplied when it differs from the canonical entity, i.e. your id was merged into this record. Null unless a merge redirect happened.

slug.description: URL slug, the site's canonical id for every type but channel. Null when never slugged.

route.description: Site-relative route of this entity's page on arcmira.com, e.g. "/org/ramp", "/person/jane-doe", "/yt/@TBPNLive". Null for a type the site has no page for.

page.description: The entity's page on arcmira.com, absolute. Link the name to it when you write the entity into an answer. Null for a type the site has no page for.

appearances_page.description: For a person, the list of their appearances on arcmira.com (their page opens on it). Null for every other type.

mentions_page.description: For a person, the list of mentions of them on arcmira.com, page/mentions. Null for every other type: their page is the mentions list already.

allOf.description: The resolved entity the recommendations belong to.

after.description: Inclusive start as an ISO instant. Null when the window has no start.

before.description: Exclusive end as an ISO instant. Null when the window has no end. Earlier than the before you sent when your plan's freshness gate cut the window.

window.description: The publication window the answer covers, [after, before) in UTC, normalized from after and before.
